They didn't serve a practical purpose, but they did serve a real one. There was a moment after the beach when we weren't sure if we'd make it to the water source. And then DaVinci drew this picture. And that moment of indecision, the one between us all, it passed. We knew what we had to do. Art is a way of making sense of things. It's not about drawing pretty pictures and it's not about taking the easy way out. It's about connecting everything else, finding the thread and holding it tight. It's a way of describing what we're feeling and seeing and experiencing, all at the same time.

If we're going to make it back to civilization, we're going to need the tools to do that. The rest of us have them — we drew that map and we put the bottle down when you asked.
